empty.collected: No collected samples waiting to be received.

collect.heading: Collect sample: {{test}}
collect.check: Check who the patient is before taking the sample.
collect.done: Collected as {{id}}. Print the label and put it on the container.

refused.alreadyCollected: Someone else already collected this sample.
refused.notActive: This order was cancelled or completed meanwhile: nothing to collect.
refused.gone: This order is no longer on the worklist.

refused.conflict: This sample changed meanwhile. The worklist was read again.
refused.notCollected: This sample can no longer be received: it was received or rejected, or its order was cancelled or completed.
refused.gone: This sample is no longer on the worklist.

reject.heading: Reject sample {{id}}
reject.of: {{test}} for {{name}}. The order goes back to be collected again.
reject.noteHint: Required when the reason is Other.
reject.done: Sample {{id}} rejected. The order is back on the list to collect.

errors.note: Say why the sample is rejected.

refused.conflict: This sample changed meanwhile. Close and look at the worklist again.
refused.notRejectable: This sample can no longer be rejected.
refused.gone: This sample is no longer on the worklist.

refused.notPrintable: This sample was rejected: its label is not printed.
refused.gone: This sample is no longer on the worklist.

results.title: Lab results
results.notFound: This lab order is not available.
results.heading: Results: {{test}}
results.notReceived: Sample {{id}} is not received yet: results are entered once the laboratory receives it.
results.enterHint: Fill in the results you have. The others can be entered later.

errors.number: Enter a number, such as 5.1 or -0.25.
errors.commentNeedsValue: Enter the result the comment is about.

refused.alreadyResulted: Someone else entered a result meanwhile. The results were read again: check them before saving.
refused.unknownTest: The tests of this order changed meanwhile. The results were read again.
refused.notOpen: This order or its sample changed meanwhile and takes no results now. The results were read again.
refused.invalidNumber: A result is not a number the laboratory accepts. The results were read again.
refused.gone: This sample is no longer available.

verify.heading: Verify results
verify.hint: Check each result before verifying it. Verified results are released to the doctor.
verify.done_one: {{count}} result verified and released to the doctor.
verify.done_other: {{count}} results verified and released to the doctor.
verify.doneCompleted_one: {{count}} result verified. Every result of the order is verified: the order is completed.
verify.doneCompleted_other: {{count}} results verified. Every result of the order is verified: the order is completed.

errors.none: Tick at least one result to verify.

refused.conflict: A result changed meanwhile: it was corrected or verified. The results were read again: check them before verifying.
refused.gone: This sample is no longer available.

amend.heading: Correct {{name}}
amend.was: Now {{value}}, entered by {{name}}. The correction replaces it and is verified again before the doctor sees it.
amend.reasonHint: Kept with the history of the result.

errors.reason: Say why the result is corrected.

refused.alreadyAmended: This result was corrected meanwhile. Close and look at the results again.
refused.notOpen: This order was cancelled meanwhile: nothing is corrected.
refused.gone: This result is no longer available.

acknowledge.already: Someone acknowledged {{name}} meanwhile. The results were read again.
acknowledge.notAcknowledgeable: {{name}} changed meanwhile and has nothing to acknowledge now. The results were read again.

trend.heading: Trend of {{name}}
trend.range: Reference range of the newest result: {{range}}
trend.tooFew: A trend needs at least two verified results of this test.

report.notPrintable: Nothing to print yet: no result of this order is verified.
report.title: Laboratory report: {{test}}
report.pendingNote: A test marked pending is reported once it is verified.
